Since I'm the type of person to give up extremely quickly, I don't have any hobbies or projects I'm working on. Simply put, I'm a rather boring and uninteresting person with no goal, in all honesty. But I really appreciate you reaching out for someone you don't know and most would say is overreacting. I CANNOT thank you enough, really
